texts: On day 17 of Year 1, the Council held an emergency meeting in the afternoon.
The Council decided to begin salt-bloom additions that afternoon.
Hesper distributed pouches of salt-bloom to the keepers of the Cliff Path.
The Council spoke to the keepers of the Northcove.
The Northcove did not need salt-bloom.
The Council recorded the cold snap in the ledger.

q1_issues.issue: "pouches of salt-bloom" is fused into a coined compound kind salt_bloom_pouch (with its genus chain), naming a kind the surface never states and dropping the containment relation between the pouches and the salt-bloom.
"that afternoon" is propagated onto the deciding event only; the adjunct more plausibly times the complement (the beginning of the salt-bloom additions), so the attachment site may be wrong.

"in the ledger" is encoded as Location, asserting a spatial location for the recording event, where the document/medium reading matches the prompt's "in a statement" case and its preposition-named In oblique.

q2_gaps: container / quantity of-phrase ("pouches of salt-bloom") - Possessive/genitive NP explicitly excludes a measure of-phrase ("a cup of water") but supplies no positive encoding for one

agent-nominalization taking an of-phrase argument ("the keepers of the Cliff Path") - Complements of nouns and adjectives rules on act/result/quality nominalizations and on relational nouns with no underlying verb, leaving an -er agent noun with a live underlying verb unruled between Of and Possession
review.notes: "the Council" is correctly treated as a capitalized common noun (no Name atom) and as a singular collective that does not distribute; the control-verb complement sk_begin_1 correctly carries no tense. The genus atoms (Inheritance cold_snap snap) and (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) rest on IS-A judgments that are not checkable for these invented terms.

issues.reason: A container / quantity of-phrase is explicitly excluded from the genitive Possession rule ("a cup of water") with no replacement supplied, and "Never coin a relation head" bars a containment head, so fusing every surface word into salt_bloom_pouch with its true genus (Inheritance salt_bloom_pouch pouch) is graceful improvisation in gap territory - no emitted atom is false or ill-typed, and the "of salt-bloom" restriction is carried in the symbol rather than dropped.

The attachment half stands - adjacency favours timing the beginning, and the parse commits to the matrix site with no Interpretation wrapper and no time on sk_begin_1 - but the falsehood half does not: the passage places the Council's day-17 decision at that same afternoon emergency meeting, so every Time atom emitted on sk_decide_1 is true of the content.

Time/Intervals fixes "in a statement" as the preposition-named In oblique rather than a named role, and Thematic roles says to decide by the question the PP answers - "in the ledger" names the record's medium, not where the recording happened, so (Location sk_record_1 sk_ledger_1) asserts a spatial location for the event that the sentence does not state.

gaps_confirmed: Container / quantity of-phrase ("pouches of salt-bloom"): the genitive rule excludes measure of-phrases without supplying any positive encoding for one.

Agent nominalization with an of-phrase argument ("the keepers of the Cliff Path"): it falls between the act/result/quality-nominalization Of oblique and the relational-noun Possession branch, which is reserved for nouns with no underlying verb.
new_gaps: Agentive support / light-verb construction over an event noun ("the Council held an emergency meeting in the afternoon"): the light-verb rule covers only occurred / happened / took place, so nothing says whether the time terms ride the matrix hold event (as parsed) or the meeting witness that IS the eventuality - as parsed, "when was the meeting?" binds nothing.
